title: Comment on “Boosting large scale capacitive harvesting of osmotic power by dynamic matching of ion exchange kinetics” by N. Chapuis and L. Bocquet, Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9, 2087
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5383-5385
